'''Krash''' was the nickname of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] hailing from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]]. A disgraced [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxer]], Krash led the kill team of the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]]. Krash was active during the Sorority's conflict with the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Gaining much success as a [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxer]], Krash lost a bout that cost him his career. Bearing a terrible facial scar from the accident, Krash kept to himself in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] throughout [[Taleucema]] where he attempted to drink himself to death, using [[spice]] to numb the pain. It was in a cantina that Krash was approached by the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]] to lead a kill team of four other, mixed race agents. Dedicated to the Sorority and shaking his addictions and shame, Krash carried a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] and [[Shockmitt|shock gloves]]. Well paid and given reasonable accommodations in Taeucema, Krash's men were equally loyal beings.<ref name="MPQ" />
